article.story: LOWELL, Mass. -- — Jasiah Cannady scored 13 points as UMass-Lowell beat Marist 63-61 on Sunday. Cannady shot 5 of 7 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the line for the River Hawks (3-0). Victor Okojie added 11 points while shooting 4 for 15, including 1 for 9 from beyond the arc while he also had eight rebounds. Jayden Harris shot 3 of 10 from the field, including 0 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line to finish with 10 points. Dywane Chess led the Red Foxes (1-2) in scoring, finishing with 20 points and seven rebounds. Marist also got 12 points from Jack Graham. Jordan Gabriel also had 10 points. Up next UMass-Lowell’s next game is Wednesday against UMass on the road. Marist visits Lehigh on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
